Permutations with $\pi(\pi(i)) = i$ for all $i$ are involutions. Requiring $\pi(i) \neq i$ means no fixed points, so every element lies in a 2-cycle. These permutations correspond exactly to perfect matchings of $\{1,\ldots,10\}$.

The number of perfect matchings of $2n$ elements is $(2n-1)!! = (2n-1)(2n-3)\cdots 3\cdot 1$. For $n = 5$:

$$9!! = 9 \cdot 7 \cdot 5 \cdot 3 \cdot 1 = 945.$$

ANSWER: 945
